$comment: Maps names as printed in RAW wiki statblocks onto what this fork actually has.
Only three kinds of divergence need an entry: a rename, a merge, or a deletion. A house rule
that changes what an item DOES needs no entry at all, because the effect lives in the pack item
and the importer adds that item by name. Toughness is the example: this fork rewrote it
entirely (5 HP plus 1 per level, stacking, plus healing) and it still needs no entry here.
from      {type, name} as the wiki prints it.
to        {type, name} in this fork, or null when the house rules deleted it outright.
A null is reported to the GM as 'dropped by house rule', NOT as an error.
collapse  true when several sources map onto one target and duplicates must be dropped.
Darth Vader carries both Block and Deflect and must end up with one Dueling Stance.
reason    the house rule this entry implements. Cite it so the entry stays auditable when
Every non-null 'to' is asserted to resolve, and every 'from' is asserted NOT to resolve, by
module_test/statblock-aliases.test.mjs. That test is the point of this file: a hand-written
table's failure mode is quietly pointing at nothing after a pack rename.
